name: TabNav
description: Mortar tab navigation: tabs that link between pages, such as settings sections, as underlined tabs or pills with optional icons and counts; the current page is marked aria-current="page".

props.label: string
props.items: TabNavItem[] ({ label: string; href: string; current?: boolean; count?: number | string; icon?: ReactNode })

contract.usage: Import { TabNav } from @tony-ui/mortar. Use it for tabs that navigate between pages; use Tabs for panels within one page.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
